outlook.statement: Government's reform initiatives to boost manufacturing sector expected to increase demand for Ferro Alloys. Key risks include geo-political tensions (US–Iran, Russia–Ukraine), impact of US tariffs on global economy, slowdown in Chinese economy, volatility in oil prices, ocean freights and exchange rates which may adversely impact demand and prices of Ferro Alloys.
The demand for Ferro Alloys is expected to grow over time in view of the Government's infrastructure spending and reform initiatives to revive the manufacturing sector.

Key risks going forward include geo-political tensions between US–Iran and Russia–Ukraine, impact of US tariffs on the global economy, slowdown in the Chinese economy and volatility in oil prices, ocean freights and exchange rates.

The appropriateness of assumption of going concern, is critically dependent upon the Company's ability to raise requisite finance, generate cash flows in future to meet its obligations and to earn profits in future. The ability of the Company to continue as a going concern is solely dependent on the successful outcome of these conditions, which are not wholly within the control of the Company.
It is expected that the overall financial health of the Company would improve after improvement in availability of working capital.

The Company manages its capital on the basis of gearing ratio which is net debt divided by total equity. The Company has arrived at an understanding with Assets Care and Reconstruction Enterprise (ACRE) for restructuring/settlement of its outstanding loan exposure vide a sanction letter dated 26 March 2026 based on approval of the restructuring/settlement. The Company's operations continue under conversion arrangement.

The Parent Company has successfully restructured its outstanding loan exposure with ACRE covering 100% of the lenders and has received a sanction letter. It is expected that the overall financial health of the Parent Company would improve after improvement in availability of working capital.
The Parent Company has arrived at an understanding with VISA Infra Limited for restructuring/settlement of its outstanding loan exposure, with waiver of interest w.e.f. 1 January 2026.

The Company has taken appropriate steps to ensure improvement in profitability in future which is subject to improvement in economic scenario and market condition. It would therefore, be inappropriate to quantify in measurable terms the likely increase in productivity and profits that may take place as a result of the steps taken by the Company.
